title: Credited Value Bands for the Trade-In Mileage Rate
content:
Under **Trade-In Agreements** the rate at which overage miles are charged carries a value-band rate share set by the value credited at pickup. The value credited is read as the total of the agreement's value-credited entries.

| Value credited at pickup | Value-band rate share |
|---|---|
| Below $6000.00 | 0.5 |
| At or above $6000.00 but below $12000.00 | 0.75 |
| $12000.00 or more | One (no reduction) |

The share multiplies the grade's mileage overage deduction per mile into the one rate at which the charged miles are priced; the mileage deduction is rounded to the nearest cent only once, at the end.

## Boundaries

| Value credited | Share |
|---|---|
| $5999.99 | 0.5 |
| $6000.00 | 0.75 |
| $11999.99 | 0.75 |
| $12000.00 | One |

## Worked example (hypothetical figures)

A trade credited $4800.00 at pickup, with a hypothetical grade rate of $0.06 per mile and 1500 miles charged: the rate per mile becomes $0.06 multiplied by 0.5, which is $0.03, and 1500 miles at $0.03 is **$45.00**.
